waxy_cuticle.name: Waxy Cuticle
waxy_cuticle.description: Transparent, hydrophobic lipid-rich cutin layer secreted by epidermal cells; prevents excessive desiccation without obstructing radiant sunlight transmission.

upper_epidermis.name: Upper Epidermis
upper_epidermis.description: Single-cell-thick protective boundary of tightly packed, transparent barrel-shaped cells devoid of chloroplasts, allowing maximum sunlight penetration to the mesophyll.

palisade_mesophyll.name: Palisade Mesophyll
palisade_mesophyll.description: Elongated columnar chlorenchyma cells packed vertically beneath the upper epidermis; contains the highest density of chloroplasts for radiant energy capture and carbohydrate synthesis.

spongy_mesophyll.name: Spongy Mesophyll
spongy_mesophyll.description: Loosely arranged spherical parenchymal cells with fewer chloroplasts; surrounded by extensive interconnected air spaces facilitating internal gaseous exchange.

intercellular_air_space.name: Intercellular Air Space
intercellular_air_space.description: Interconnected microscopic gas channels linking sub-stomatal chambers to mesophyll cell surfaces, permitting rapid internal diffusion of carbon dioxide and oxygen.

lower_epidermis.name: Lower Epidermis
lower_epidermis.description: Ventral protective cell monolayer punctuated by numerous stomata; covered by a thinner cuticle than the upper surface to facilitate gaseous exchange while shaded from direct sun.

bundle_sheath.name: Bundle Sheath
bundle_sheath.description: Protective ring of tightly packed parenchyma and sclerenchyma cells enclosing the vein, providing mechanical rigidity and regulating solute entry into conductive tissues.

xylem_vessels.name: Xylem Vessels
xylem_vessels.description: Non-living, hollow conduits with lignified cell walls situated on the adaxial (upper) vein surface; transports water and dissolved mineral ions upwards from roots via transpiration pull.

phloem_sieve_tubes.name: Phloem Sieve Tubes
phloem_sieve_tubes.description: Living, enucleated conductive tubes associated with companion cells situated on the abaxial (lower) vein surface; translocates manufactured sucrose bidirectionally throughout the plant.

sub_stomatal_cavity.name: Sub-Stomatal Air Cavity
sub_stomatal_cavity.description: Internal air chamber situated directly internal to the stomatal pore, serving as a reservoir for saturated water vapour prior to transpirational loss.

guard_cells.name: Guard Cells
guard_cells.description: Pairs of specialized photosynthetic epidermal cells with differentially thickened inner cell walls; swell to open the stomatal aperture when turgid and relax to close it when flaccid.

stomatal_pore.name: Stomatal Pore
stomatal_pore.description: Microscopic aperture between adjacent guard cells that regulates carbon dioxide influx for photosynthesis and water vapour efflux during transpiration.
